reasons: Relies on pinned data and on a model-based synthesis step.
Scan export failures are not logged, unlike prepared export failures.

terms.meaning: One web address and the code that answers requests sent to it.
A written analysis that combines findings into slide text.
A proposed change to a slide that the user can review, accept or dismiss.
An error type that carries an HTTP status code for problems with a deck.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and router setup
sections.what: Loads the web framework, validation library, database, scan and deck helpers, then creates the router that holds this tool's routes.
sections.why: Likely reason: the file gathers the helpers needed for the demo routes in one place.
sections.watch_out: Imports reach into other folders with long relative paths, so moving files breaks them.

sections.name: jsonQuery
sections.title: Reading JSON text from an address
sections.what: Turns a text value from the web address into data, and rejects it when it is not valid JSON or is longer than the size limit.
sections.why: Lets query strings carry lists and settings as JSON text.
sections.watch_out: The size limit is 64000 characters, so very large edit lists are refused.

sections.name: preparedQuery
sections.title: Validating prepared demo requests
sections.what: Defines the allowed prepared demo options: which tool, whether an amendment applies, a list of text edits and chart settings. Defaults to the scan tool and no amendment.
sections.why: Checks inputs before any work starts.
sections.watch_out: Up to 100 text edits are allowed, and each text is capped at 12000 characters.

sections.name: get
sections.title: Serving the prepared demo and its export
sections.what: Returns the prepared walkthrough as data. When the export address is used, it applies chart and text changes to a copy, adds the recorded amendment if asked, and sends a PowerPoint download.
sections.why: The walkthrough must be replayable without changing the saved run.
sections.watch_out: Chart changes are refused for the lessons tool, and a missing amendment target returns a conflict error.

sections.name: ScanExportChartBody
sections.title: Chart settings for scan export
sections.what: Defines the chart settings the scan export accepts: the size basis (equal, capex or capacity), project ids and an optional note.
sections.why: Keeps chart input within known options.
sections.watch_out: Project ids are limited to 2000 per request.

sections.name: post
sections.title: Scan export from selected projects
sections.what: Validates the request, loads the selected projects and their active evidence quotes, builds scan data and synthesis, and returns a PowerPoint download. It returns a conflict error if synthesis is unavailable.
sections.why: A complete deck needs its written analysis, so export stops rather than producing a partial file.
sections.watch_out: Chart project ids are silently narrowed to the selected projects, so a chart can show fewer points than the user asked for.

summary: Defines the web addresses that deliver the guided demo walkthrough, a PowerPoint export of the pinned scan, and a scan export for projects a user selects.
purpose: Serves the prepared demo data and a PowerPoint download for the demo, and builds a scan export from selected LNG projects.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The comments say the replay reads only and applies edits to a copy.
how: The prepared route checks request inputs, loads the prepared demo, applies optional chart settings, text edits and the recorded amendment to a copy, builds a PowerPoint file and returns it. The scan export route checks the selected projects, loads their evidence, builds synthesis and refuses to export if synthesis is not ok.
inputs: For the prepared route: tool name, amended flag, text edits and chart settings in the address. For scan export: an industry, a list of project ids, and optional chart settings in the body.
outputs: JSON for the prepared view, or a PowerPoint file download. Errors come back as JSON with a status code.
risks: Edits and chart changes apply only on the export route, so the plain prepared route ignores them. Unexpected errors in scan export return no server log.
debug: A 409 means pinned data no longer matches or synthesis failed; read the message. A 400 means input validation failed. For prepared export failures, check the console for the guided-demo prepared error log.
